summary: CAISO moves to hold the show cause proceeding in abeyance for 90 days. It lays out a stakeholder schedule leading to a November 16, 2026 FPA section 205 filing, made together with its Participating Transmission Owners.
ask: Hold the EL26-71 section 206 proceeding in abeyance for 90 days, until November 16, 2026, while CAISO and the Participating Transmission Owners prepare section 205 filings.

points.point: CAISO wants 90 days from the response deadline to November 16, 2026, aligned with the Participating Transmission Owners' requests.
points.quote: hold the instant proceeding in abeyance for 90 days from the deadline to respond

points.point: The filing is meant to address all preliminary findings and five reform categories in the order, with simultaneous PTO filings.
points.quote: will address all the preliminary findings and five categories of reforms set forth in the Order to Show Cause, as appropriate for the CAISO region.

points.point: CAISO's Large Load stakeholder initiative is the vehicle; an issue paper came in January 2026 and a technical-requirements straw proposal in June 2026.
points.quote: The CAISO’s ongoing Large Load stakeholder initiative will become the vehicle for CAISO reforms to address the Order to Show Cause.

points.point: Most tariff changes should take effect on approval; software-dependent items such as new settlement charges may take longer.
points.quote: The CAISO expects that the vast majority of its tariff revisions will be able to become effective as soon as approved by the Commission.

points.point: The schedule runs a straw proposal in August, a draft final in September, governing body votes October 20 and 28, and a November 16 FERC filing.
points.quote: two discrete proposals: a straw proposal in August and draft final proposal in September, before seeking Western Energy Market Governing Body and Board of Governors approval

points.point: CAISO and the PTOs keep the existing split of responsibilities and coordinate weekly.
points.quote: including multiple weekly meetings among various teams of subject-matter experts for the categories of issues identified by the Commission.

throughLine.text: Requests the up-to-90-day abeyance option in the E-10 CAISO show cause order, offering the description of a future section 205 filing and the timeline the order required. FERC granted it August 14, 2026.
